jobs.title: Manager Breakfast, Minibar and Room Service
jobs.description: Step into a role that redefines excellence at the Sheraton Stockholm Hotel, a hallmark of hospitality since 1971 in the heart of Sweden's bustling capital. Aligned with our innovative owners Archer Hotel Management and Marriott International, we merge rich cultural history with modern luxury and a deep dedication to sustainability. We are now looking for a passionate F&B leader to oversee our Breakfast, Room Service, and Minibar operations. This is a fixed-term full-time position covering parental leave, for a minimum duration of 6 months. For this role, we are looking for someone who is responsible, flexible and enjoys problem solving. You are a team player who has a passion for service to exceed our guests' expectations. As Breakfast, Room Service & Minibar Manager, you will run one of the most important parts of the guest experience and you will be the key person in ensuring that we deliver outstanding customer service. The role involves identifying areas for improvement, implementing strategic solutions and collaborating with various departments to ensure guests receive a first-class experience at all times. Main responsibilities: Take a leading role in planning, organizing and managing your operations on a daily basis. Supervise and assist in the service of quality food & beverage products to customers in the breakfast/lunch operation. Ensure that the quality of the breakfast buffet is always kept to the highest standard. Ensure guest requests are fulfilled and problems solved in a timely manner. Ensure that the mini bar operation runs smoothly in terms of visual aspect, refilling and stock control. Ensure all VIP amenities are delivered on time and according to standard. Perform admin duties such as scheduling, ordering and inventory control as requested by senior management. Do employee performances reviews whenever required. Develop a structured training plan for all team members and assure product quality and service standards are being followed at all times. Assist other F&B outlets when required by covering shifts and supporting fellow managers. Optimize profitability and work toward the restaurant´s set financial results by delivering long- and short-term efficiency goals. Lead the team towards the set guest satisfaction goals by coaching, inspiring and motivating the staff toward guest-focused results. Lead the recruitment process of new team members for your department. Qualifications: You have at least 3 years experience working in a similar position at a high-end restaurant and/or hotel where you had responsibility to lead a team. Ambitious and interested in working in a high-pace environment with great standards. Out-going personality who has the ability to communicate with ease and ensure our guests feel welcome. Structure and good organizational skills. Extensive knowledge of food and drinks. Experience with demand-driven scheduling. Knowledge within profitability optimization and cost control. Ability to work independently, pro-actively and with high professional ethics. You are passionate about service as well as have a genuine interest in food and beverage. Able to communicate verbally in Swedish and English, additional languages is a plus. Ability to motivate and inspire teams. Excellent problem-solving skills with a focus on guests' needs and expectations. What We Offer: Chance of being part of one of the biggest renovation and re-positioning projects in Stockholm’s hotel scene. Great opportunities for career growth. A dynamic and inclusive work environment. Employee discounted rates at over 8,000 hotels worldwide. Does this position sound interesting and like a good fit for you? Selection and interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis and the position may be filled before the final application deadline, so please submit your application as soon as possible. Join our team and play a key role in creating memorable experiences for our guests!

jobs.title: Global Incident Manager
jobs.description: When critical IT incidents occur, clear coordination and decisive action make all the difference. As Global Incident Manager, you lead the response to major and high-impact incidents, bringing the right people together to restore services quickly and minimize business impact. You join Service Management and work within the Service Stability area alongside Global Incident Managers and colleagues focused on Incident, Problem and Event Management. About the job You’re the central coordination point during major and critical IT incidents, creating structure, driving progress and ensuring clear communication, escalation and decision support. Your scope covers global Incident Management operations, including major incidents, escalation support and Cybersecurity Incident Management (CSIM) when assigned. Your focus is operational incident leadership, while using hands-on experience and lessons learned to continuously improve our ways of working. Job responsibilities Lead and coordinate the end-to-end response to P1, major and other high-impact incidents. Establish effective command and control, with clear responsibilities, action tracking and decision points. Bring together resolver teams, service providers, technical specialists and business stakeholders to drive incidents toward resolution. Remove blockers and escalate when service restoration, business continuity, security or regulatory targets are at risk. Provide timely and clear communication to operational teams, business stakeholders and leadership. Facilitate post-incident reviews, follow up lessons learned and improvement actions, monitor recurring issues and contribute to improvements in processes, tools and capabilities. Take part in on-call duties and respond to incidents outside normal business hours, according to the agreed operational model. Location The position is based at the World Trade Center in Stockholm or Mossvägen in Sandviken. Your profile You’ve built solid experience in Incident Management or a similar operational IT field and know how to coordinate major incidents in complex environments. Working across multiple stakeholders comes naturally to you, and you combine operational IT knowledge with a structured approach to service management. Your background includes: Experience with IT service-management processes and tools in a global or multi-stakeholder environment. A relevant university degree or equivalent practical experience in IT operations, service management or a related field. ITIL Foundation or an equivalent service-management certification. Professional proficiency in written and spoken English. Experience in process improvement, governance, cybersecurity incident response or crisis management is beneficial. Advanced certification within ITIL, Incident Management, security, process management or crisis management, as well as additional relevant languages, are also considered an advantage. Being calm and decisive under pressure, you create clarity when situations are complex and moving quickly. You communicate clearly with technical, business and leadership audiences, take ownership and persistently drive incidents toward service restoration. You’re comfortable influencing others without formal authority while turning incidents and deviations into opportunities for learning. Our culture Our role is clear – through every action, every day, we make the shift and advance the world through engineering. We believe in an inclusive, equal and open-minded culture, and we nurture our diversities to form a solid foundation for achieving great results. Add fair and rewarding benefits, as well as many different career options. Are you intrigued? Visit our website, LinkedIn or Facebook page to get to know us further. Contact information For further information about this position, please contact Mikael Maad, hiring manager, +46 (0)70 616 28 44 We’ve already decided on which advertising channels and marketing campaigns we wish to use and respectfully decline any

jobs.title: IT Service Manager
jobs.description: Company description: At NKT in Karlskrona, we develop and manufacture high voltage power cables that enable the transition to renewable energy. Here, you will be part of an international engineering centre with advanced high voltage test halls, modern cable production and the cable laying vessel NKT Victoria. As Connectors, we collaborate to develop innovative technology that connects a greener and more sustainable world. NKT is headquartered in Denmark and operates in more than 30 countries.NKT - We connect a greener world. www.NKT.com. Job description:At NKT, we are engaged in innovative projects that drive the green transition. Our complex cable installations, both offshore and onshore, utilize the latest technology to ensure quality and efficiency. Managing the entire process from production to testing requires careful planning and coordination. We’re now looking for a communicative and motivated IT Service Manager to manage business-critical IT services and digital projects. You’ll play a key role in supporting our global operations and developing scalable IT solutions that meet evolving business needs. Take responsibility for business-critical IT services and lead projectsAs a Service Manager, you will manage the full lifecycle of assigned IT services and ensure reliable, secure and cost-effective delivery. Working closely with business stakeholders, IT teams and external vendors, you will translate business requirements into effective solutions and support continuous improvement. Your main responsibilities will include: • Ensure stable IT services across on-premises and cloud environments.• Manage and coordinate changes, releases and digital projects.• Build solid stakeholder and vendor relationships.• Manage service improvements while ensuring IT governance and security. You will report to Sr Manager Digital Solutions. The location for this position is Karlskrona. Communicative IT Service Manager with digitalization experienceTo perform well in this role, you have solid knowledge of digitalization and the ability to analyze business needs and translate them into IT solutions. You are structured, cost-conscious and strategic, with good communication and collaboration skills. Knowledge of IT infrastructure is an advantage. Your CV should also include: • Relevant education in IT or equivalent experience• Professional experience in delivering and managing IT services and systems• Familiarity with agile methods and service management frameworks such as DevOps and ITIL• Experience managing external vendors• Fluency in spoken and written English. Swedish language skills are meritorious. Join a skilled team in an international environmentWe believe that a diverse organization enables sustainable performance, and that an inclusive and welcoming culture makes for a better workplace. We are committed to a diverse organization and a culture where people from different backgrounds and perspectives can thrive and be inspired to perform at their best. You will have exciting opportunities to develop your career and enjoy attractive benefits. Are you interested in a career at a growing company while contributing to the green transition? Then we would like to talk to you. Even if you don’t meet all the requirements – tell us. The opportunity to grow and contribute to our future is important, where your involvement and potential matter greatly. “Working as a Service Manager in NKT gives you the opportunity to see how many different parts of the whole NKT business works. You are not working towards one business area or function, but many. As a Service Manager you cannot know all the details, but you get a good understanding in general. Focus is always on understanding the business needs and translating them into requirements that will end up in tangible solutions. A Service Manager needs to be a strong team player who collaborates effectively, supports colleagues, and works toward shared goals” says one of the Service Managers in Digital

jobs.title: Senior ServiceNow Platform Architect
jobs.description: Nordic Investin has been asked to find a Senior ServiceNow Platform Architect for one of our partner companies. You want technical choices, delivery and production behaviour to reinforce each other, even when the constraints are difficult. The partner is strengthening its capability in scalable ServiceNow architecture for enterprise workflows and service management. You will connect ServiceNow, platform architecture and integrations while ensuring that data model and security receive appropriate discipline. The aim is practical progress that colleagues can use, leaders can evaluate and the organisation can sustain. The environment rewards early questions, visible trade-offs and engineering discipline. Security and operability belong in the design. How you will work You will work with product, architecture, security, operations and domain colleagues. The partner values short feedback loops, evidence from real systems and direct communication. This role calls for independent judgement and the ability to raise the quality around you. You are expected to make trade-offs visible, recognise when a decision needs wider expertise and move work forward without creating unnecessary process. What you will do Own the practical direction for scalable ServiceNow architecture for enterprise workflows and service management. Translate goals and constraints into a clear approach for ServiceNow and platform architecture. Establish useful standards, routines or decision artefacts around integrations. Coordinate stakeholders and dependencies affecting data model. Use evidence and measurable outcomes to improve security. Strengthen knowledge sharing and sustainable ownership through release governance. What you will bring Relevant experience delivering scalable ServiceNow architecture for enterprise workflows and service management in a demanding environment. Strong working knowledge of ServiceNow and platform architecture. Practical experience applying integrations and data model. Ability to assess priorities, risks and trade-offs involving security. Evidence of clear stakeholder communication and dependable end-to-end ownership. Professional English and the judgement to work with sensitive or business-critical information. Experience that would add value Experience from large enterprises and shared service organisations. Exposure to release governance in a cross-functional or multi-team environment. Swedish language skills or experience working across Nordic organisations. A background that can succeed here Your background may be product engineering, platform work, enterprise technology or consulting. What matters is technical depth connected to user and business consequences. Direct experience of scalable ServiceNow architecture for enterprise workflows and service management is valuable, while adjacent experience counts when it shows transferable judgement. What makes the opportunity interesting The role offers meaningful ownership and the opportunity to influence both the solution and the decisions around it. The focus on scalable ServiceNow architecture for enterprise workflows and service management gives the opportunity a clear mission and room to influence priorities and success measures. jobs.title: ITSM Process and Tool Manager
jobs.description: Job DescriptionAs ITSM Process and Tool manager in Arelion, you will be accountable for effective ITSM processes and an ITSM platform that enable consistent incident, problem, change, and request management. The role aligns process governance, tool configuration, integrations, access, reporting, and continual improvement to reliable service delivery and evolving business needs.Arelion operates a complex IT environment consisting of a DC/IaaS hybrid running a variety of applications, both COTS and in-house developed. We depend on highly skilled people in Arelion and within our support partners to be able to follow efficient processes every day to keep lights. They need the best possible tooling to join forces to solve incidents, investigate complex problems, and handle planned changes. This is where the ITSM Process and Tool manager can make a big difference. You will take over a working foundation, govern it over time, and improve to facilitate even better collaboration and increase efficiency. ​Job RequirementsAt least five years of relevant IT service, operations, support, or ITSM experience in a managed-service environment Strong practical knowledge of ITIL processes and experience delivering service quality within an ITIL framework Experience administering and configuring ITSM platforms (preferably Freshservice), including workflows, access roles, integrations, dashboards, and reports to facilitate efficient ways of working with incidents, problems, and changes. Understanding of IT infrastructure, operating systems, AWS, data centre technologies, VMware, CMDB, monitoring, and asset-management concepts Strong written and spoken English, stakeholder communication, vendor coordination, planning, organisation, and structured problem-solving Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience, with ITIL Foundation certification beneficial Job ResponsibilitiesGovern and improve Incident, Problem, Change, and Request Management processes within the ITIL framework Maintain and configure the ITSM platform to support approved service-management processes and workflows Align forms, workflows, dashboards, and reports with organisational and stakeholder needs Manage platform roles, permissions, and access controls for secure and appropriate use Coordinate integration of the ITSM platform with monitoring, CMDB, asset-management, event/alarm sources, and other relevant systems Monitor process and tool performance, service-level compliance, and data quality, and address identified issues Collaborate with infrastructure, application, engineering, support, service-delivery, and supplier stakeholders Maintain clear process, configuration, and operating documentation Identify and implement opportunities to simplify, standardise, and optimise IT service management Job BenefitsAnnual performance/KPI based bonus ATK - work time shortening Wellness contribution Pension plan

You will ensure safe, efficient, and high-quality service delivery while driving operational excellence, employee development, customer satisfaction, and business growth. Working closely with Sales, Project Management, Performance Centers, Product Management, and regional Operations teams, you will play a critical role in strengthening Valmet’s position as the preferred service partner for Tissue producers. Primary Location: Karlstad (Sweden) or another major Valmet location in EMEA. Your responsibilities In your daily work, you will: Lead, coach, and develop a team of Field Service Engineers, Specialists, and Technicians located in Karlstad and other key EMEA service hubs. Manage resource planning, workforce allocation, and competence development to ensure efficient execution of field service activities. Ensure effective coordination between Field Services, Project Teams, Performance Centers, Engineering, and Product Organizations. Drive standardization and continuous improvement of service processes, methods, tools, and best practices. Act as an escalation point for critical customer issues and ensure timely resolution of customer concerns. Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, innovation, and customer focus throughout the organization. Support the development and execution of strategic initiatives related to service growth, digitalization, remote services, and operational excellence. Expectations for you We expect you to bring: A degree in Engineering or equivalent technical experience. Several years of experience in industrial field services, maintenance, tissue production, project management, or related service operations. Proven experience in people leadership, team development, and performance management. Good knowledge of Tissue production technologies, maintenance practices, and customer operations. Experience managing multicultural teams and working within an international business environment. Apply now for the Service Agreement Sales Manager position and help us shape the future of energy! Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization.
